card.name: Disposable and one-time-use wording
card.fires_on: The ending of 'disposables' after 'dispos', and '-time' after 'one' in 'one-time use'. Seen in labels about single-use vials, syringes and equipment.

modes.label: one-time use
modes.description: The word 'time' after 'one-' in phrases saying an item is for one-time use.
modes.example: EYLEA pre-filled glass syringe is sterile and for one<<-time>> use in one eye only.

modes.label: disposables
modes.description: The ending 'ables' of 'disposables' when discussing items to be discarded.
modes.example: all associated dispos<<ables>> for the contrast media transfer set.
